notes.title: Patch Note 1.03
notes.content:
-Added 1 active ability
-Added 2 passive abilities
-Finished the guiding system to help the player find important things.
-1 new Enemy
-Created a killingspree system. killing more enemies in a short duration will grant you bonuses and might trigger certain passives.
-Create a system where when you crit some enemy´s head will explode.
-Fixed the mutant.
-Now The hound enemy will deal damage on collision as well. it works like a charge attack.
-Fixed ammo crate.
-and some other minor fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
I have received feedback from players that the game is very unclear about certain mechanics. I created some solutions to help with that.

Additionally, I am tracking and trying to solve all the bugs. I might create some way for any player to give me feedback.



PATCH NOTE

-Now it is clear when you are out of ammo. There is a sound and a warning. 

-more clear that the perma weapon has infinite ammo.

-Shows more clearly that you do not have enough points to get an ability chest or a gunchest.

-Fixed the initial chest not appearing

-fixed the quests not working

-Created a hint system that will work as a tutorial to help the players understand the basics of the game.

-Added two passives

-Fixed some minor bugs
